dct_title_s: Generalkarte von Nordamerica: samt den Westindischen Inseln
dct_alternative_sm: Generalkarte von Nordamerica: samt den Westindischen Inseln
dct_description_sm: Relief shown pictorially.; Sheets numbered 20-23.; Title in decorative cartouche on sheet no. 20.; Inset map on sheet no. 21: Specialkarte von der Baffin und Hudsons Bai.; Inset map on sheet no. 22: P. Eusebius Franz Kino aus der G.J. endeckte zwischen dem 1698 und 1701 J. dass Californien eine Halbinsel sey.; Scales and legend on sheet no. 23.; Includes descriptive and historical notes throughout map. Shows boundaries, forts, roads, mines, and Indigenous villages and tribal territory.; At lower right of sheet no. 20: "Gestochen von J. Stenger in Wien."; Prime meridian: Ferro.; Library's copy: pieces are joined into a single sheet, with sheet margins trimmed from interior of map.
